_about: Known crossover votes in the 119th Congress (2025-26) by members still serving in 2027. +1 = voted for the policy against their party, -1 = against it. Sources: Senate S.J.Res.37 (Canada tariffs, 51-48, Apr 2025); Senate Iran war powers (47-53, Jun 2025); Senate reconciliation bill (51-50, Jul 2025); Senate rescissions (51-48, Jul 2025); House SAVE Act (220-208, Apr 2025); House H.J.Res.72 (Canada tariffs, 219-211, Feb 2026). House ACA subsidy extension (230-196, Jan 8 2026): 17 Republicans voted yes; 5 are still serving in 2027.
